title: Import duty exemptions reach UAH 39B in October
summary: Customs duty exemptions granted on imported goods totaled UAH 39 billion in October 2026, equivalent to 51.6% of customs revenues paid into the state budget, which reached UAH 75.4 billion during the month.

title: Russia redeploys strategic bombers to protect them from attacks – Ukrainian Air Force
summary: Russia is redeploying its strategic bombers, particularly following Ukrainian strikes on military airfields, in an effort to protect its aircraft from further attacks.

title: Elina Svitolina finishes as runner-up at 2026 WTA Finals
summary: The 2026 WTA Finals, the season-ending tournament of the Women's Tennis Association, has concluded in Indian Wells, USA.

title: Washington joins Empty Chairs action in support of Ukrainian journalists detained by Russia
summary: The Embassy of Ukraine in the United States joined the international Empty Chairs action in support of Ukrainian journalists, writers and human rights defenders illegally detained by Russia.

title: Dutch company withdraws lawsuit against Ukraine’s honorary consul in Netherlands over alleged ties to Russia
summary: Dutch company Peja Group has withdrawn an urgent court application against Karel Burger Dirven, Honorary Consul of Ukraine in the Netherlands, whom it accused of allegedly making defamatory statements about its business ties with Russia.

title: Ukraine’s air defense neutralizes three Russian missiles, three Banderols, 205 drones
summary: As of 12:00 on Tuesday, November 17, Ukraine's air defense forces had neutralized three Kh-59/Kh-69 guided aerial missiles, three S8000 Banderol/Dan-T missiles and 205 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine since the evening of November 16.

title: General Staff confirms strike on Gazprom oil refinery in Bashkortostan
summary: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat facility in Russia's Bashkortostan overnight on November 17, approximately 1,500 kilometers from the Ukrainian border.

title: Russian drone strikes police vehicle in Sumy region, two officers injured
summary: Two police officers were injured when a Russian drone struck a police vehicle in the town of Hlukhiv, Shostka district, Sumy region.

title: USF commander shows drones used in strike on Crimean Bridge
summary: Robert Brovdi, commander of the Unmanned Systems Forces of the Ukrainian Armed Forces, has shown the drones used in the strike on the Kerch Strait Bridge.

title: Arch and road span collapse: General Staff confirms results of strike on Crimean Bridge
summary: The arch and a span of the road section of the Kerch Strait Bridge collapsed following a strike by Ukraine's Defense Forces overnight on November 17.

title: Families with children ordered to evacuate from Balabyne in Zaporizhzhia region
summary: Families with children have been ordered to evacuate from the settlement of Balabyne, near Zaporizhzhia, under an order issued by the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration.

title: Russian forces strike Mukachevo in Zakarpattia region
summary: The Russian military attacked the city of Mukachevo in Ukraine’s western Zakarpattia region on November 17.

title: Germany to contribute $300M to new PURL package with Patriot missiles – Pistorius
summary: Germany will contribute $300 million to a new package of U.S. weapons purchases for Ukraine under the PURL initiative, jointly funded with Norway. The package will focus primarily on strengthening Ukraine’s air defenses by providing missiles for Patriot systems.

title: Palianytsia struck road section of Crimean Bridge, Neptune, Ruta, and FP-5 hit rail section - Zelensky
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky has revealed details of the operation targeting the Crimean Bridge, saying it consisted of seven stages carried out over several weeks.

title: Russia opposes separate Black Sea deal without a peace agreement, Turkish FM says
summary: Russia does not want to reach an interim agreement with Ukraine on the Black Sea without a comprehensive peace deal. Turkey is working on proposals to facilitate an agreement and discussing them with both the Ukrainian and Russian sides.

title: Russian strike cuts power to more than 300 settlements in Rivne region
summary: More than 300 settlements in the Rivne region have been left without electricity following a Russian attack this morning.

title: Emergency power outages affect four regions following Russian attacks
summary: Emergency power outages have been introduced in the Dnipropetrovsk, Kirovohrad, Poltava, and Kharkiv regions due to equipment damage and a drop in voltage in the high-voltage grid following Russian attacks.

title: Russian drone strikes parking lot in Vinnytsia, killing one woman and injuring another
summary: A woman was killed and another injured when a Russian drone struck a parking lot in Vinnytsia.

title: Ukrainian Armed Forces hold first-ever sergeants’ forum in Kyiv
summary: The Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU) have held a Sergeants’ Forum, the first event of its kind in the history of the modern Ukrainian military.

title: Russian attack on Kyiv kills two, injures one
summary: Two people were killed and another was injured in a Russian attack on Kyiv on November 17.

title: Ukraine should join NATO, must not give up territory in exchange, Estonian DM says
summary: Estonian Defense Minister General Martin Herem has said that Ukraine should not have to give up any of its territory in exchange for NATO membership.

title: Fire breaks out at a petrochemical complex after attack in Russia’s Bashkortostan – media
summary: Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat, one of Russia’s largest petrochemical complexes, was targeted in an attack in the Republic of Bashkortostan.

title: Russian missile strike on Smila damages industrial facilities, injures six
summary: A Russian missile attack on Smila, Cherkasy region, damaged industrial infrastructure and a vocational education institution, injuring six people. Hourly power outage schedules have also been temporarily suspended in Uman district.

title: Kyiv’s Northern and Southern Bridges remain closed as experts assess damage from Russian attack – Klitschko
summary: Experts are assessing damage to Kyiv’s Northern and Southern bridges caused by a Russian missile attack in the early hours of November 17.

title: Russian attack on industrial facilities in Zaporizhzhia kills one, injures nine
summary: One man was killed and nine people were injured in a Russian attack on industrial facilities in Zaporizhzhia.

title: 317 buildings in Kyiv’s Darnytskyi district left without heating after Russian attack
summary: A total of 317 residential buildings in Kyiv’s Darnytskyi district remain without heating in the aftermath of a Russian attack.

title: One of Crimean Bridge’s arches damaged in second strike
summary: One of the two arches of the Crimean Bridge was damaged in a second attack in as many days, media reports say.

title: War update: 135 combat engagements on front line over past day
summary: On November 16, a total of 135 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invading forces were recorded along the frontline.

title: Russian shelling reported in four Kyiv districts, one person injured
summary: The consequences of Russian attacks on Kyiv on November 17 have been recorded in four districts: Holosiivskyi, Desnianskyi, Dniprovskyi and Obolonskyi.

title: Russian army loses another 1,620 personnel, four MLRS in Ukraine
summary: Russia's total estimated combat losses since the beginning of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from February 24, 2022, to November 17, 2026, have reached approximately 1,627,040 personnel, including 1,620 over the past 24 hours.

title: Car driver killed in drone attack on Zaporizhzhia
summary: A car driver was killed in a drone attack on the Kosmichnyi district of Zaporizhzhia.

title: Traffic suspended on Kyiv's Northern and Southern bridges following Russian attacks
summary: Traffic on Kyiv's Northern and Southern bridges has been temporarily suspended following Russian attacks on the capital, and public transport routes have been diverted.

title: Woman rescued from rubble of damaged industrial facility in Zaporizhzhia
summary: A woman has been rescued from the rubble of a damaged industrial facility in Zaporizhzhia. Her condition is stable.

title: Military evacuate last resident from village in Sumy region
summary: Ukrainian troops have evacuated the last remaining resident of the village of Kyianytsia in the Sumy region.

title: Khmara following UDCG meeting: Partners' contributions help strengthen Ukraine's air defense
summary: Ukraine's top priority this winter is protecting its skies. Contributions announced by partners at the Ukraine Defense Contact Group meeting will help strengthen the country's air defense, including through the procurement of missiles under the PURL initiative.

title: Seven drones enter Moldovan airspace
summary: Seven drones were detected in Moldova on November 17, violating the country's airspace amid massive Russian attacks on Ukraine.

title: Khmara comments on strike against Kerch Bridge
summary: Ukraine plans to triple its long-range strike capabilities in 2027, including increasing the number of jet-powered drones.

title: Part of Kyiv’s Livoberezhnyi district to temporarily lose heating
summary: Some buildings in Kyiv’s Livoberezhnyi residential district will temporarily be left without heating due to repair work.

title: Zelensky calls on US to enable satellite communications to target ballistic missile launchers
summary: The United States could help strengthen Ukraine’s defense by enabling satellite communications to target enemy ballistic missile launchers located near Ukraine’s borders.

title: Russian drone strikes park in Dnipro, injuring two people
summary: Russian forces struck a park in the city of Dnipro, leaving two people injured.

title: Drone debris falls in park area in Kyiv’s Desnianskyi district
summary: Debris from a drone fell in an open area in Kyiv’s Desnianskyi district.

title: Germany, Norway to contribute $300M each toward U.S. arms purchases for Ukraine – Pistorius
summary: Germany and Norway will jointly finance a new package of U.S. weapons for Ukraine under the PURL initiative, each contributing $300 million.

title: Sweden allocates additional SEK 720M in military aid to Ukraine
summary: Sweden will provide approximately SEK 720 million in additional funding for multilateral funds and initiatives supporting Ukraine’s defense.

title: Russian strike on central Vinnytsia injures four
summary: Four people sought medical attention following a Russian attack on Vinnytsia on Tuesday evening.

title: Germany to supply Ukraine with new radars for future Freyja air defense system – Pistorius
summary: Germany will provide Ukraine with new high-performance radars to enhance its air surveillance capabilities. The radars will form a key component of the future Freyja anti-ballistic missile defense system.

title: German Defense Minister highlights Ukraine’s battlefield gains at Ramstein, urges greater pressure on Russia
summary: Russian forces suffered their heaviest monthly losses in October since the start of the full-scale invasion, while Ukrainian forces regained more territory than they lost through successful counteroffensive operations.

title: Strike on Kerch Bridge marks another impressive success for Ukraine – Austrian colonel
summary: Ukraine’s Defense Forces have achieved an impressive result by causing an arch of the Kerch Bridge’s road section to collapse, despite the extensive protection system Russia had spent several years building around the structure.

title: UK defense secretary praises Ukraine's strike on Kerch Bridge, calls year terrible for Putin
summary: The United Kingdom welcomes the Ukrainian Defense Forces' operation against the Kerch Strait Bridge.

title: Russian military transport plane crashes, 17 feared dead
summary: A Russian An-12 military transport aircraft has crashed in the Kemerovo region, with 17 people reportedly on board, according to Russian media.

title: Bundeswehr tests Ukraine’s DELTA system, considers adopting it – Pistorius
summary: The German Army tested Ukraine’s DELTA digital battlefield management and situational awareness system during a drone warfare exercise in October. Germany now plans to further develop the system jointly with Ukraine and assess its suitability for Bundeswehr use

title: Kyiv begins preparations for tunnel under Dnipro with help from US company Robbins
summary: Ukraine's Minister for Restoration, Infrastructure and Transport Mykola Kalashnyk has held a working meeting with representatives of U.S. company Robbins to discuss the construction of a tunnel under the Dnipro River, including the technology and preparations for the project.

title: Ramstein: Zelensky proposes swapping partners’ Patriot and IRIS-T missile stockpiles for future deliveries
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky has proposed that Ukraine receive interceptor missiles for Patriot and IRIS-T systems currently held in partner countries’ stockpiles in exchange for missiles already ordered by Ukraine but scheduled for production and delivery at a later date.

title: UK to announce new commitments to strengthen Ukraine's air defenses – defense secretary
summary: The United Kingdom will announce new commitments to strengthen Ukraine's air defenses. Allies must turn their existing commitments into real military capabilities to help Ukraine get through a difficult winter and ensure long-term defense support.

title: Rutte on strike on Crimean Bridge: Ukraine must defend itself, including by targeting Russian logistics
summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has said that strikes on Russian logistics hubs are an inevitable part of Ukraine's defense, adding that footage showing the aftermath of the attack on the Kerch Strait Bridge suggests the Ukrainian operation may have been successful.

title: UK urges allies at Ramstein to commit to military support for Ukraine through 2027
summary: International partners must provide Ukraine with military assistance not only to help it weather a difficult winter but also throughout 2027, enabling it to continue holding the front line and maintain a strong position in future negotiations.

title: Over 1,000 air defense missiles: UK announces GBP 240M military aid package for Ukraine
summary: The United Kingdom is providing Ukraine with a GBP 240 million ($316 million) military aid package that will include more than 1,000 additional short-range air defense missiles and over a dozen air defense radars.

title: Missiles and equipment: Sweden, UK to help arm Ukraine’s Gripen fighter jets
summary: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara, Swedish Defense Minister Pål Jonson, and UK Defense Secretary John Healey signed a letter of intent in Brussels outlining further cooperation under the Gripen for Ukraine initiative.

title: Korolivskyi Smak plant in Kirovohrad region destroyed following Russian strike
summary: Korolivskyi Smak, a Ukrainian producer of sunflower oil and other food products, has permanently halted production after a Russian strike triggered a large-scale fire that destroyed the facility.

title: Ukraine, Finland sign memorandum on joint defense production
summary: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara and Finnish Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen signed a memorandum on joint defense production during a meeting in Brussels.

title: Ukraine harvests 68.2 Mt of grain and oilseed crops
summary: As of November 17, Ukrainian farmers had harvested 50.1 million tonnes of grain crops, including 26.26 million tonnes of wheat, as well as 18.1 million tonnes of oilseed crops.

title: EU to assist Ukraine in developing customs IT systems
summary: The European Union will provide Ukraine with expert, financial and technical support through October 2029 to develop the customs IT systems required for the country's accession to the EU.

title: Axios: Witkoff, Kushner to meet Ukrainian, EU officials to discuss peace plan
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff are planning to meet with Ukrainian and European officials this week to discuss security guarantees and a plan for Ukraine's postwar economic recovery.

title: BTA Bank to rebrand as NovaBank
summary: NOVA Group has completed its acquisition of JSC BTA Bank and is moving ahead with its integration with NovaPay, paving the way for operations under the NovaBank brand.

title: Moldova temporarily closes six border crossing points with Ukraine following Russian drone attack
summary: Moldova temporarily closed six border crossing points with Ukraine on November 17 after Russian drones violated its airspace.
